run_franka_blockstacking_example: run the franka blockstacking example in Habitat with random agent actions and optional RGB rendering
run_example_without_rendering: run the franka blockstacking example with the --no-render flag to skip RGB display output
create_habitat_env_with_config: create a Habitat environment using habitat.Env with a YAML config file via habitat.get_config
add_rigid_cube_objects: add scaled cube objects to the Habitat simulation using the rigid object manager and template handles
run_random_agent_episode: run a random agent episode by sampling actions from env.action_space until the episode is over
